correctness.rationale: Fixed simplices are unions of pair-orbits of sigma with >=2 isolated ground points. The signed augmented Lefschetz sum is -sum_F(-1)^(number of selected pair-orbits). Invert g(U)=(1-1)^(number of permitted pair orbits) over the Boolean lattice of ground cycles to obtain L~=(-1)^c(f_1^2-3f_1+1). Nilakantan-Singh Theorem 1.3 gives concentration in degree n-4; Hopf trace then gives the claimed sign-twisted character. Ordered-pair permutation module decomposes as 1+2 S^(n-1,1)+S^(n-2,2)+S^(n-2,1,1), yielding exactly two sign-conjugate Specht constituents; neither trivial nor sign. Independently enumerated signed fixed faces for every 5,7,11,15 conjugacy cycle type at n=4,5,6,7. Finite n corroborates, not proves the quantified all-n statement.
